jobs.description:
The opportunity
As a Supply Chain Engineering Specialist, you will serve as the dedicated SCM representative in cross-functional 
projects, ensuring that all supply chain and supplier-related activities are planned, executed, and delivered on time.
You will act as the single point of contact for Supply Chain Management within projects, coordinating activities across Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Quality, Engineering, Production Quality and others. You will own and drive all SCM-related deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
How you'll make an impact
Act as the SCM representative and primary SCM interface in new product introduction (NPI), product change, product phase-out and factory improvement projects.
Coordinate supplier-related project deliverables, ensuring material availability, supplier readiness, and
on-time execution of project milestones.
Manage the end-to-end procurement process for project materials, including RFQs, supplier evaluations, sourcing recommendations and purchase order execution.
Lead supplier selection with strategic buyers to identify the best long-term supplier.
Identify supply chain risks, proactively develop mitigation plans, and escalate issues when required.
Initiate and follow up supplier qualification activities together with Supplier Quality Engineering
Secure material availability for pilot production, zero series, and production start.
Support continuous improvement of product implementation and industrialization processes from a supply chain perspective.

Your background
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations,
or equivalent experience.
Experience working with suppliers and cross-functional teams in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
Good understanding of sourcing processes, supplier selection, commercial negotiations, and supply chain risk management.
A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with a proven ability to tackle complex problems, prioritize actions and deliver results under changing conditions
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple parallel activities and stakeholders.
Self-driven and a strong sense of ownership
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Fluent in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

Meritorious:
Knowledge of manufacturing processes and supplier networks
Previous experience within Supply Chain Management, procurement or related activities
Experience working in ERP systems, preferably SAP.
Experience with PPAP, NPI processes, supplier qualification, or quality assurance

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​
Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Eva Schölin, eva.scholin@hitachienergy.com

Silex Microsystems is the world’s leading pure-play MEMS foundry, customizing solutions for prominent global clients in industries such as pharmaceuticals, consumer electronics, and automotive. We are looking for a driven Process Engineer who takes ownership, brings people together, and turns ideas into improvements in our DRIE Area. If you have experience in production and are ready to take responsibility and drive progress, this could be your next step.
Would you like to know more about Silex and what we do? Read more here.
The DRIE Area is a vital part of our MEMS production, where silicon is removed in a controlled way to create the structures of each device. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across production and engineering to keep processes stable and drive continuous improvement.
About the role
You will take ownership of process improvements, coordinate activities, and follow through from identifying an issue to implementing a solution. Your primary duties will include:

Drive the development and improvement of etching processes for MEMS manufacturing.

Take a structured approach to investigating process issues and driving improvements in quality and performance.

Coordinate development batches and take ownership of resolving production stoppages together with relevant teams.

Bring the right people together to resolve process-related issues and follow through on agreed actions.

Work with the internal service team at Silex as well as with suppliers to ensure equipment stability.

Collaborate with Product Managers to ensure customer requirements and delivery targets are met.

 Who we are looking for
We place particular emphasis on your drive, personality, and willingness to take ownership. You take initiative, create clarity around priorities, and bring others with you to move work forward. You are comfortable taking responsibility, following through on commitments, and asking for input when needed.

A master’s degree in physics, chemistry, electrical engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Professional industry experience, including experience working in a customer focused production environment.

Written and verbal fluency in English, Swedish is considered highly meritorious.

A structured way of working, with the ability to prioritize, document your work, and follow up on results.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build trust and engage colleagues across teams.

It is also beneficial if you:

Have experience in MEMS or CMOS manufacturing, where experience in DRIE processing is considered particular beneficial

Have experience from cleanroom environment.

About Silex
Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS technology is moving into an abundance of modern innovations; from data centers, consumer and automotive electronics to medical diagnostics and life science.
With a team of expert engineers, operators, technicians, and specialists, Silex brings the ideas of the industry’s leading MEMS innovators to life. We collaborate with some of the world’s largest technology giants and visionary startups across industries such as medicine, life sciences, consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive, and industrial sectors.
More about the recruitment process
To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few brief questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test, reference checks, and a background check. Additionally, a drug test will be conducted prior to employment, and we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.
We look forward to your application and welcoming you to this exciting journey!

Combine ICT leadership with hands-on technology in an international manufacturing environment!
Are you an experienced ICT professional who enjoys both leading people and working hands-on with technology? Do you thrive in a role where you can combine strategic thinking with operational problem-solving and make a real impact on the business?
Gnutti Carlo Group Sweden is looking for a Country ICT Manager to lead and develop our ICT operations across our two manufacturing sites in Sweden.
About the Role
As Country ICT Manager, you will have overall responsibility for ICT operations, infrastructure, cybersecurity and development across our Swedish sites.
You will be part of the Swedish Management Team, reporting directly to the Managing Director Sweden, with a functional reporting line to the Group ICT Officer.
The role is placed in our manufacturing site outside Vimmerby. You have two direct reports, one ICT technician in our site in Kungsör and one ICT-technician in our site outside Vimmerby.
This is a role that combines leadership, strategic development and hands-on operational ICT work. You will not only lead and develop the ICT function but also be actively involved in day-to-day IT operations, technical troubleshooting and finding practical solutions to support our business.
Working closely with Production, Engineering, Maintenance and other functions, you will ensure that ICT supports both daily operations and future business development.
Your Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the Swedish ICT function across two manufacturing sites.

Take an active, hands-on role in daily ICT operations, technical support and problem-solving.

Ensure reliable, secure and efficient ICT infrastructure, networks and services.

Drive ICT improvements, digitalization and projects in alignment with Group ICT strategy.

Support IT/OT integration and collaborate closely with manufacturing operations.

Manage cybersecurity, ICT budgets, external suppliers and service providers.

Act as a trusted ICT partner to local management and the global ICT organization.

Who Are You?
We are looking for a hands-on, business-oriented ICT leader who enjoys combining technical expertise with leadership and continuous improvement.
We believe you have:

Solid experience in ICT infrastructure, networks, servers and IT operations.

Previous leadership experience and the ability to develop people and drive improvements.

Experience from manufacturing or other complex industrial environments.

Strong technical problem-solving skills and a willingness to work operationally when needed.

Good understanding of cybersecurity and preferably IT/OT integration.

Experience working with ICT projects, suppliers and international stakeholders.

Strong communication skills in English.

Most importantly, you are a pragmatic and solution-oriented leader who is equally comfortable discussing ICT strategy with management as rolling up your sleeves to solve technical challenges.
 
Ready to combine leadership with hands-on technology?
Join us and help shape the future of ICT in Sweden. We look forward to receiving your application no later than November 27, 2026.  Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position may be filled before the application deadline.
About us
Gnutti Carlo Group is owned by the Italian company Gnutti Carlo S.p.A. Together, we form a global organization with more than 4,000 employees across Sweden, Italy, Germany, the Czech Republic, the United Kingdom, Austria, India, China, the United States, and Canada.
We are a world leader in the development and supply of heavy-duty, high-performance valvetrain and fuel injection components for engines used in construction, agriculture, marine applications, power generation, and transportation.
In 2026, Ljunghäll AB and Gnutti Carlo Sweden joined forces to form Gnutti Carlo Group Sweden.
In Sweden we have approximately 900 employees. 300 in our manufacturing site in Kungsör and 600 in our manufacturing site outside Vimmerby.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineers  Handheld R&D  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
At Handheld R&D, we develop the next generation of handheld products used by professionals and consumers worldwide. We are now looking for Mechanical design engineers to join us, depending on the team, you will work with either chainsaws or products such as leaf blowers, trimmers, brushcutters, hedge trimmers and pole products.
Our teams are involved throughout the entire product lifecycle, from new product development to continuous improvements of our existing portfolio. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, bringing together expertise from R&D, production and testing to develop solutions that deliver real value to our users.
With access to modern prototype facilities and labs, you will work alongside skilled and passionate colleagues who share a strong interest in engineering, problem-solving and creating great product experiences.
Role Description
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will play an important role in transforming needs, requirements, and innovation into robust and manufacturable components and products. Your responsibilities include:
-         Driving design, development, and improvements of mechanical components for chainsaws, with a main focus on injection-molded plastics and die-cast parts.
-         Generating, developing, and evaluating concepts.
-         Conducting root cause analysis to understand problem areas and ensure effective problem-solving within design, production, and validation.
-         Ensuring robust designs through simulation and geometric requirements.
-         Working in CATIA V5, where previous experience is an advantage, and the PLM system Teamcenter.
-         Collaborating cross-functionally with lab, design, calculation, production, R&D, and external suppliers.
Your Profile
You are a team-oriented person who enjoys sharing knowledge and solving problems together with others. You bring a humble, driven, creative, and curious approach, always eager to learn and grow.
You feel comfortable in a fast-changing environment where you take ownership of your tasks and deliverables. And you work in a structured way and are used to planning your work so that we can reach our goals together.
We are looking for someone who is not only technically skilled but also thrives in a collaborative and open culture. To succeed in this role, we believe you are:
-         Experienced in mechanical design, with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering or a similar field.
-         Fluent in English and Swedish.
Location
 Our team is based in Huskvarna, where we strongly believe in the value of working closely together. Some flexibility is possible, but we aim for on‑site presence since collaboration is at the core of how we work.
Application
 Please apply with CV and Cover letter. We do not accept applications by email due to GDPR regulations.
For more questions regarding the positions please contact: Hiring Manager - Product Design: Jakob Engström, jakob.engstrom@husqvarnagroup.com or Hiring manager – Chainsaw: Joel Ahlander, joel.ahlander@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.
Winning Through Culture 
 We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.   
Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities. 
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on. 
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! 
Learn more about our culture here.

We are looking for an HVAC Engineer to join our Sweden factory and support the reliable, safe and energy-efficient operation of HVAC and related utility systems.
About Senior Material Europe
At Senior Material Europe, we manufacture separator film – a thin film used in lithium-ion batteries, including batteries for electric vehicles. The separator is a key component that helps make lithium-ion batteries safer, more durable and more efficient, supporting the transition towards a more electrified future.
Our production is modern, advanced and operated under controlled cleanroom conditions. The manufacturing process consists of four main process steps, where precision, stability and quality are essential.
Together, we are building advanced manufacturing capabilities in Europe and developing solutions that make a difference – both today and for the future.
The Role
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to develop their technical skills through practical experience in a modern industrial environment. You will take part in daily operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, technical modifications and engineering projects, with the opportunity to gradually develop into an engineer capable of independently managing HVAC and utility engineering work.
You will work closely with colleagues within engineering, maintenance, production and other functions, as well as external contractors, maintenance providers and equipment suppliers.
Job Responsibilities
Be responsible for the daily operation, inspection, maintenance and troubleshooting of utility systems.

Participate in technical modifications, optimisation, energy-saving and consumption-reduction projects for HVAC systems and related utility facilities.

Assist in collecting and analysing equipment operating data and contribute to optimising operating conditions.

Participate in scheme development, on-site implementation, commissioning and acceptance of HVAC equipment and system modification projects.

Assist in coordinating external maintenance providers, contractors and equipment suppliers, and follow up on on-site issues through to completion.

Maintain and improve HVAC equipment registers, technical documentation, maintenance standards and related management documents.

Support the operation and engineering projects of other utility disciplines when required.

Complete other tasks assigned by the supervisor.

Your Background
We are looking for someone with:

A full-time bachelor's degree or above in HVAC, Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering, Energy and Power Engineering, or a related field.

Strong professional fundamentals and a genuine interest in developing technical and engineering skills.

Good English communication skills, both spoken and written, with the ability to communicate about technical matters in an international factory environment.

A strong sense of responsibility and good communication and coordination skills.

The ability to work independently when needed and solve technical problems in an on-site factory environment.

The ability to adapt to hands-on field work and a practical engineering environment.

Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
It Would Be an Advantage If You Have
Experience or an internship in HVAC system design, equipment operation and maintenance, engineering modifications or a related area.

Familiarity with CAD.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Previous experience from an industrial, manufacturing or technical environment.

An interest in energy efficiency, system optimisation and continuous improvement.

What You Can Expect
You will join an international industrial organisation where engineering plays an important role in supporting safe, reliable and efficient factory operations.
The role offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience with HVAC and utility systems, participate in technical projects and work closely with experienced colleagues and external technical partners.
We value responsibility, collaboration, continuous learning and straightforward communication. You will have the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge through practical experience and gradually take on greater responsibility within HVAC and utility engineering.

About the role

Meet and build strategic partnerships with key suppliers to follow up on cost, quality, delivery, sustainability, innovation, and improvement plans.

What we are looking for

Skills & Competencies 

Curious and eager to learn commercial and procurement disciplines.

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, we believe you are results-oriented with strong business acumen.

Collaborative and capable of working globally and across functions, we believe you have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills as well as ability to bridge technical and commercial discussions.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Fiber Technicians at Optic Tunnels
jobs.description:
Optic Tunnels is a new Swedish provider of data communication and AI services for demanding organizations – services produced on truly dedicated infrastructure, all the way down into the ground. To deliver them, we are building an entirely new, independent fiber backbone network between the Nordic capital regions, with strict requirements for security and performance at every step. Our services are launched step by step as the network grows, for customers along the entire route – not only between the endpoints. The network build-out is well underway, initially focused on Greater Stockholm, the Mälaren Valley, Dalarna and Skåne, and we are now looking for experienced fiber technicians who want to join us on the journey.
The role
As a fiber technician at Optic Tunnels, you will work with fiber installation and high-precision fusion splicing, as well as measurement and documentation. You will work closely with the civil works, follow each route from trench to completed connection, and take part alongside our subcontractors when the fiber cables are installed in the ducts.
The work is largely in the field along our backbone network, but also in our own small data centers along the routes and at end-customer premises. This means flexible, mobile working days with a high degree of responsibility for planning your own work.
A strategic capability we are building in-house
While Optic Tunnels procures most of the network build-out from external contractors, all fiber splicing, measurement and documentation is carried out by our own staff. This is to ensure maximum control and security in the most sensitive parts of the network.
Measurements and documentation of splice quality and the optical properties of the fiber matter more to us than to most. The measurement data is used not only to verify that the fiber and the splice meet specification at the moment of testing, but also as a reference for detecting anomalies and intrusion attempts throughout the fiber's lifetime. This is a central part of our security offering, which is why careful measurement and impeccable documentation are as important as the fiber and the splices themselves.
What we are looking for
•      Documented experience as a fiber technician on backbone networks
•      A category B driver's license
•      The right to work in Sweden
•      Good computer skills and experience working with documentation
•      Fluent spoken and written English, the language of all our technical documentation. Working knowledge of Swedish is a plus.
You are orderly and meticulous, and you see documentation as a critical part of the work, not an add-on to it. You enjoy planning your own work and taking responsibility for it.
Terms
Location: Stockholm. The work involves travel and work throughout Optic Tunnels' network.
Extent: Full-time
Type of employment: Permanent, following an initial probationary period
Start: By agreement. Positions are filled on a rolling basis.
Working hours: The work is mainly carried out during daytime. Some tasks, such as planned maintenance within scheduled maintenance windows, may be carried out at other times. Around-the-clock on-call duty for repairing infrequent network faults is included on a rotating schedule, with compensation under the applicable agreement.
Applications and questions
Send a description of yourself and your experience as a fiber technician – the types of networks and projects you have worked on, and your responsibilities in them – together with details of your references, to jobs@optictunnels.com. We will only contact your references once we have agreed with you to do so. Questions about the position are welcome at the same address. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
Read more about Optic Tunnels at www.optictunnels.com.

jobs.occupation: Product Cost Specialist to Axis Communications
jobs.description:
If you would like to become a part of a great team with highly skilled and motivated professionals, working in an innovative and developing environment, continue reading! They are a growing team and are now looking for a Product Cost Specialist for a temporary assignment, covering the period from November 2026 to September 2027.
About the role
Who is your future team?
Axis Manufacturing Capacity and Cost team is a great contributor to our company's success by developing our base of manufacturing partners and specifically secure cost competitiveness and constant improvements to our purchase costs. Your responsibility will be to ensure the right cost on Axis products through finding opportunities and driving cost reductions from our contract manufacturers, in close collaboration with your colleagues.
Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We believe you are analytical and have a great eye for details, at the same time you easily see the bigger picture from a holistic perspective. You are ambitious, self-driven and very result oriented. You thrive in collaboration with others and see the benefit of working towards common goals. You are open and your communication skills help you in reaching your goals. We see that you are curious and persistent in the work to make sure that the area of responsibility is delivered. Discussions and negotiations with internal as well as external partners are something that you enjoy, as part of your collaboration skills.
This position is very important as you will have great opportunity to affect a significant part of Axis total cost and by this, have the opportunity to affect and make a big difference to our business and continued success.
Work tasks
Be responsible for negotiating and approving product cost quotations from Axis contract manufacturers throughout the product life-cycle.
Be responsible for identifying and driving cost reduction activities towards our contract manufacturers by analyzing quotation data and having good understanding of all relevant cost drivers.
Work in close cooperation with our contract manufacturers to achieve timely implementation of Axis negotiated component prices in product quotations.
Analyze and maintain product and component database from internal and external sources and create a benchmark to be used in price reduction activities with contract manufacturers.
Support RFQ process for new products and provide input to our product development organization regarding product cost structure and different cost drivers.
Follow-up and optimize different parameters affecting purchase cost of components at our contract manufacturers, such as order quantities, demand changes and delivery terms.
Contribute and give input to process- and IT- tools improvements within area of responsibility, independently or in collaboration with other relevant functions.

The position will mean some travels abroad.
We are looking for
A degree in Industrial Economy or Business Administration.
Minimum 5 years of supply chain/sourcing experience from international manufacturing companies.
Proven record of at least 2 years of business negotiations.
Experience from analyzing big amounts of data.
Excellent MS Office skills.
Excellent skills in English, both orally and in writing.

It’s good if you have experience from working in ERP systems and if you have knowledge about business culture in different parts of the world, it will benefit you greatly in your future role.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story. As the category leader in dermatology, we bring together science, innovation and people who are passionate about making a meaningful difference for patients around the world.
We are now looking for a QC Analyst to join our Quality Control team in Uppsala. This is a great opportunity for someone with a microbiology background who is looking to further develop their expertise within Quality Control in a highly regulated environment.
In this role, you will contribute to ensuring product quality, patient safety and compliance through microbiological testing, data review and collaboration with colleagues across the organization.
 
Your team
You will join a team of approximately 14 colleagues united by a strong commitment to quality, collaboration and continuous improvement. The team combines deep expertise with a collaborative mindset, creating an environment where knowledge is openly shared, challenges are solved together and everyone contributes to common goals.
There is a strong sense of teamwork, mutual respect and accountability within the group. Open communication, a willingness to support one another and a shared ambition to succeed create a positive working environment where people are encouraged to grow, contribute and perform at their best.
 
Your mission
As a QC Analyst, you will perform and review microbiological quality control activities in accordance with established methods, regulatory requirements and agreed timelines. You will support routine laboratory operations while contributing to the continuous improvement of processes, methods and ways of working.
Working closely with colleagues across Quality, Manufacturing and Technical Operations, you will help ensure that microbiological testing is performed accurately, efficiently and in compliance with applicable requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Perform microbiological analyses according to approved methods, SOPs and quality standards.
Review, evaluate and document analytical results in accordance with established procedures.
Support routine quality control activities within the microbiology laboratory.
Ensure laboratory documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner.
Participate in investigations, deviation management and root cause analyses.
Support method validations, change controls and continuous improvement activities.
Review and update laboratory documentation and work instructions as required.
Ensure that laboratory equipment is maintained and used according to approved procedures.
Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders to maintain high standards of quality and compliance.

 
Your profile
We are looking for someone with a background in microbiology and experience from a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices or food production. You are structured, curious and eager to learn. You enjoy working in a laboratory environment, paying attention to details and following established procedures. You collaborate well with others, communicate clearly and take responsibility for delivering high-quality work.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Science or a related scientific discipline.
Experience working in a laboratory environment within a regulated industry.
Knowledge of GMP and quality requirements.
Experience with microbiological testing or related laboratory activities.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

 
Preferred Experience
Experience working within Quality Control.
Experience with environmental monitoring or environmental sampling.
Knowledge of microbiological laboratory techniques and quality systems.
Experience supporting investigations, deviations or change controls.

 
Location and information 
This position is based in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Odlings- och produktionsledare på The Culinary Farm
jobs.description:
Market Garden Production Manager 
Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden · March–November 2027 

We are looking for an experienced grower to take responsibility for the day-to-day production of The Culinary Farm starting in 2027.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys the pace, responsibility and problem-solving that comes with running a productive market garden.
About us 
Nominated as one of the Top 50 Farms in Europe, The Culinary Farm is a small-scale, diversified market garden in the heart of Skåne, southern Sweden
We grow a wide range of seasonal vegetables using agroecological principles, with a strong focus on flavour and quality. Our produce is grown primarily for chefs and our veggie-bag members in Malmö, Lund and Höör.
The farm also serves as an educational platform for Market Gardening in the Nordics.
Each season, we welcome 10–15 interns from around the world who join us for an immersive training in human-scale regenerative agriculture. 
The role 
As Market Garden Production Manager, you will be responsible for turning the seasonal crop plan into an efficient day-to-day operation, taking charge of all aspects of our production from seed to harvest.
You will: 
Plan weekly and daily production priorities.
Lead, organise and work alongside our interns.
Stay on top of sowing, planting, cultivation, irrigation and harvest.
Maintain high standards of quality and efficiency.
Identify bottlenecks and improve workflows.
Keep essential production and harvest records.
Ensure tools, irrigation systems, machinery and infrastructure are functioning properly.
How you work matters 
We are looking for someone who:
Is physically fit and enjoys working outside in all weather conditions Works efficiently and with purpose.
Is highly organised and strong at prioritising.
Sees both the immediate task and the bigger production picture. Takes initiative and solves problems independently.
Communicates clearly and leads by example.
Is self-motivated and also motivates others.
Creates structure, energy and a strong working pace within the team. Enjoys teaching and helping others develop their skills
Genuinely enjoys the intensity and variation of market gardening.
Experience 
You should have:
At least 1–2 full seasons of commercial vegetable-growing experience.
Experience with small-scale diversified vegetable production or Market Gardening. Knowledge of soil health, crop management and protection against pests & diseases. Experience leading, supervising or organising others.
Good communication skills in English.
A valid driving licence.
The legal right to work and live in Sweden.
Relevant horticultural or agricultural education is an advantage, but not required. Swedish is a plus, not a requirement.
What we offer 
The opportunity to lead in an established and ambitious market garden.
Work in an international team of young, passionate and driven change-makers
A role within our wider educational work around Market Gardening and human-scale food production in the Nordics.
A nice sun-kissed farmer’s tan
We work hard and maintain high standards, but we also want the farm to be a place where people enjoy working, learning and developing together.
Practical details
Position: Market Garden Production Manager
Location: Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden

mployment:

När ett företag växer snabbt blir struktur, kontroll och effektiva processer avgörande. Där kommer du in i bilden. 
Vill du vara med och bygga upp ekonomifunktionen i ett växande bolag där du får arbeta brett inom både redovisning och lön? Trivs du i en dynamisk miljö där du får ta ansvar, utveckla processer och vara med och påverka? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig.
Om rollen
Vi söker nu en Redovisningsekonom till ett växande företag där du får en central roll i den dagliga ekonomihanteringen. Rollen är bred och operativ med ansvar inom redovisning, löneadministration och finansiell regelefterlevnad. Du blir en viktig del av verksamheten och får möjlighet att bidra till att skapa effektiva, skalbara och hållbara ekonomiprocesser i takt med företagets fortsatta tillväxt.

Arbeta med leverantörsreskontran, fakturahantering, betalningar och avstämningar samt stötta kundreskontran genom fakturering, uppföljning och kontoavstämningar. Du samordnar löneprocessen och säkerställer korrekta löneutbetalningar samt hanterar tillhörande administration och rapportering. 
Rollen omfattar även balansavstämningar, deltagande i månads- och årsbokslut samt stöd vid moms-, skatte- och revisionsarbete. Du säkerställer att ekonomiska processer följer gällande regelverk och interna rutiner samt bidrar aktivt till utveckling och effektivisering av ekonomifunktionen.
Du är
Du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller finans och har några års erfarenhet av arbete inom redovisning, löneadministration eller liknande ekonomifunktion. Du har en god förståelse för redovisningsprocesser och känner dig trygg i det löpande ekonomiarbetet. Har du erfarenhet av löneadministration är det starkt meriterande. 
Som person är du noggrann, strukturerad och har en god administrativ förmåga. Du gillar att ta initiativ, ser förbättringsmöjligheter och trivs i en miljö där arbetsuppgifter och ansvar utvecklas över tid. Du är flexibel, prestigelös och samarbetar gärna med kollegor i olika delar av verksamheten. Vi ser också att du har goda kunskaper i Excel samt erfarenhet av att arbeta i affärs- och lönesystem.
Erfarenhet av Monitor är meriterande.
Du måste kunna tala och skriva obehindrat på både engelska och svenska. 
Du får
Här erbjuds du en varierad och utvecklande roll där du får arbeta nära verksamheten och få en bred förståelse för ekonomifunktionen. Du blir en del av ett växande bolag där du får möjlighet att vara med och bygga upp rutiner, processer och arbetssätt för framtiden. 
Du får stor möjlighet att påverka både din egen roll och verksamhetens utveckling samtidigt som du arbetar i en entreprenöriell miljö med korta beslutsvägar och nära samarbete med ledning och kollegor. För rätt person finns goda möjligheter till både professionell utveckling och ökat ansvar över tid. 
Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.
Ansökan
I denna rekrytering samarbetar företaget med FSK Group AB. Ansvarig rekryterare är P-A Karlsson och Kaisa Lindqvist. Ansök via www.fskgroup.se.
Vi är FSK, the Generator – ett bolag som driver utveckling och tillväxt genom våra tre affärsområden:Talent – Vi hjälper framåtlutade företag att hitta rätt människor, framförallt inom Management, Sales och Marketing.
Brand – Vi stärker varumärken genom Employer Branding och Business Branding.
Growth – Vi skapar inspirerande och utmanande utbildningar som utvecklar bolag för framtiden.

We're looking for a Marketing Art Director to help shape how THE FINALS and ARC Raiders look everywhere outside the game: in campaigns, key art, trailers, merch, and partner work.
You'll sit in the Marketing team and work side by side with the Game Art Directors on both titles. Together you'll keep each game's identity consistent from in-game to out, and find ways to bring great marketing work back into the games. You'll set the visual direction, build the systems that let others execute it well, and stay hands-on when the work needs it.
Example of responsibilities 

Partner with game Art Directors to expand Embark’s 2D art production capabilities, unlocking new opportunities for marketing campaigns

Lead art direction across marketing campaigns, keeping the full asset suite consistent across key art, paid media, trailer slates and motion graphics in partnership with game Art Directors.

Build brand design systems that turn our games’ visual identities into scalable toolkits for campaigns and advertising.

Create and maintain style guides so agencies and partners can apply the brand correctly and consistently across digital, print, merch and licensing work.

Explore new visual territory for upcoming marketing opportunities through concept references, mockups and mood boards.

Present creative work with clear reasoning that ties visual choices to channel requirements, audience insights and expected impact.

Direct internal artists, agencies and freelancers, and give feedback that is kind, clear and actionable.

Who you are

A bridge between strategy and craft. You can shape the big-picture direction and then roll up your sleeves to make it real.

A systems thinker. You design for scale, so a single idea can carry from a trailer slate to a T-shirt without losing its identity.

Curious about what's next. You keep up with new tools, techniques and design principles to help us lead rather than follow trends.

A natural collaborator. You like partnering with game teams, respect their vision and look for chances to make in-game and out-of-game work stronger together.

A generous leader. You make the people and partners around you better through clear direction and thoughtful feedback.

Passionate about games, especially ours. You're excited to bring our worlds to life for our players and community.

We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind

Experience as an Art Director or Senior Designer in marketing or brand, ideally for games, entertainment or consumer brands.

A portfolio showing campaign work and brand systems you've led, from first concept to final execution across several channels.

Deep knowledge of the channels where marketing art lives (social, paid media, store pages, out-of-home, broadcast, print, merch, licensing) and what each one demands.

Proven experience building brand identities, design systems or style guides that other teams and partners have used at scale.

Experience directing external partners such as agencies and freelancers alongside internal artists.

Strong skills in typography, layout, colour and composition, plus solid knowledge of motion design principles.

Comfort with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects) or similar tools, and the ability to jump in hands-on.

Interest in emerging technologies, and experience integrating these into your workflows

Clear communication in English, written and spoken, including presenting to stakeholders.

 
At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

Convert theoretical results into reality in actual design suggestions in cooperation with product development team.

Strong background in structural dynamics, earthquake engineering, and finite element analysis.
Knowledge of material behavior, damping characterization, and experimental modal testing.
Experience with HV substation equipment, direct circuit breakers is a plus.

On behalf of our client we are searching for a Test Factory Expert with focus on safety.
Assignment description
Your primary role will be to drive and lead SHE and Continuous Improvement (CI) as Test Factory Expert across Test Factory in Lund. As a Test Factory Expert, you will lead improvements related to safety ways of working, ensuring compliance with the Swedish Work Environment Act and supporting a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
You will work across the full Test Factory organization in Lund, collaborate with the Test Factory’s in Modena, Italy, when relevant, and report to Test Factory Integration.
Your responsibilities will include:
Driving a proactive and business-oriented approach to safety, order, and workplace standards within the test halls. A key part of the role is to be present in the daily operations, supporting test engineers and teams with a high-quality approach focused on safety, risk prevention, and sustainable ways of working.
You will be responsible for driving and coordinating improvement activities related to Fire Safety, Electrical Safety, Chemical Safety, Pressurized Equipment, and safety rounds in the test halls. You will lead awareness sessions, training activities, and workshops to strengthen safety knowledge and engagement across Test Factory.
As the Test Factory Expert you will drive the collection, analysis, and follow-up of incidents, deviations, and losses connected to the test environment, ensuring root causes are identified and sustainable corrective actions are implemented. You will coach and support teams and contribute to the continuous development of an agile and safe Test Factory.

To fit this role we believe you are someone who combines personal engagement with a strong improvement mindset, can build collaboration across teams, empower colleagues, and drive a proactive safety culture through visible leadership and continuous improvement.
